SIGNOZ_MCP_URL.title: SigNoz MCP endpoint
SIGNOZ_MCP_URL.description: SigNoz Cloud: keep the default and edit the region segment to match yours — `https://mcp.<region>.signoz.cloud/mcp` (regions: us, us2, eu, eu2, in, in2; find yours under **Settings -> Ingestion**, or see the [region reference](https://signoz.io/docs/ingestion/signoz-cloud/keys/)). Cursor connects to this URL and starts the Cloud OAuth login. Self-hosted SigNoz: enter your own HTTP `/mcp` URL, for example `http://localhost:8000/mcp`.
